# Weekly desk review — week ending Friday 2026-10-02

The desk's first full trading week (Mon 2026-09-28 → Fri 2026-10-02, 5 market days).
Paper desk only; no orders placed by this review. Source of truth: Alpaca paper
broker fills (`GET /v2/orders?status=closed`, 78 terminal orders, FIFO-matched per
symbol, options ×100 multiplier). Every number below comes from broker fills or
market-data bars. Evidence scripts and raw data live in
`desk/reviews/_scratch-weekly-2026-10-02/`.

## 1. Market context (desk/context/2026-10-02.json)

- Index trend: **UPTREND** — QQQ $742.02 vs 50-day avg $715.65, 20-day slope +4.61% (SPY disagrees).
- Sector rotation: tailwind SOXX (+14.9% 20D), XLK (+7.8% 20D), industrials; headwind XLB (-8.3% 20D), XLF (-7.2% 20D), XLRE.
- Event risk: none this week (next: CPI 2026-10-14). News flow: quiet across the basket — but the news fetch FAILED in the 10-02 context build, so that day's sentiment input is missing; treat 10-02 context as price/sector-only.

## 2. Week P&L by sleeve
